pages.text: Gold ingots in the corners, comparators on the four edges, and a Splitter in the center make one Smart Splitter. It keeps the Splitter shape with a green tint.

pages.title: Configure the Outputs
pages.text: Right-click to configure $(thing)Left$(), $(thing)Center$(), and $(thing)Right$(). Each output has its own mode and nine item templates.$(br2)Left and right are viewed from the input, looking in the direction items travel. Holding a belt still lets you attach it to a port.

pages.title: Unassigned and Overflow
pages.text: $(thing)Unassigned$() distributes items normally, sharing them across available outputs.$(br2)$(thing)Overflow$() is used only when no matching regular output can accept the item. Full, disconnected, and filter-rejecting regular outputs are skipped. Multiple overflow outputs share items.

pages.title: Whitelist and Blacklist
pages.text: $(thing)Whitelist$() accepts only the listed item types; an empty whitelist accepts nothing.$(br2)$(thing)Blacklist$() rejects the listed types; an empty blacklist accepts everything.$(br2)Filters also apply when belts or other inventories pull items from an output.

pages.title: Ghost Item Templates
pages.text: Click a template slot with an item on the cursor to save its type without taking the item. JEI items can be dragged directly into any slot.$(br2)Left- or right-click with an empty cursor to clear it. Filters ignore item count and NBT. Changing modes preserves templates; duplicates move to the chosen slot.

pages.title: Routing Example
pages.text: Whitelist iron ingots on the left, blacklist iron ingots in the center, and set the right to Overflow.$(br2)Iron normally goes left; other items go center. If the matching destination jams, items go right. If every eligible destination is blocked, the item waits safely inside the splitter.
